title: Patatas Bravas Bites
description: Crunchy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, these bite-sized Spanish potato treats are smothered in a rich, nutty bravas sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the potatoes and cook for 5-7 minutes, until golden brown.
Transfer the potatoes to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a separate saucepan, heat the nutty bravas sauce over low heat.
Add the chopped shungiku leaves (if using) and stir to combine.
Dip each potato cube into the bravas sauce to coat.
Serve the patatas bravas bites hot, garnished with additional shungiku leaves if desired.
